settings.title: Protect keys from AI tools
settings.intro: Decides what Manar does when an AI tool opens a key or secret file on a Linux computer. Your own terminal, ssh, git and cloud tools are never blocked.
settings.keysHint: SSH keys, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud credentials, and npm, PyPI and GitHub tokens are blocked until you allow that program. .env files are only reported.
settings.allHint: Also blocks .env files, Kubernetes and Docker config, and browser cookies and logins.
settings.offHint: Nothing is blocked. Every time an AI tool opens a secret, it shows in the timeline.
settings.platforms: Blocking works on Linux. On Windows, Manar reports and cannot block yet. If you ever cannot read your own key, stop the service: sudo systemctl stop manar-edge.
settings.failed: We could not load or save this setting. Try again.

secrets.moveHint: Moving an SSH key takes it out of its file. Your own ssh and git keep working in a new terminal, and AI tools ask you before they can use it. Undo any time with: manar-edge vault restore --all.
secrets.wantsRestore: {program} wants to take your SSH keys out of the Manar vault
secrets.stepUpNote: This releases a secret to your own device. Confirm it is you (sign in again) first. Passkeys will replace this step.

aiSpend.title: AI spend
aiSpend.subtitle: What your AI tools cost, from the model calls DOOR (the local gateway) sees.
aiSpend.unavailable: We could not load your AI spend.
aiSpend.empty: Usage appears here once a protected tool makes a model call through DOOR.
aiSpend.unpriced: priced at the highest list price
aiSpend.estimate: Amounts are estimates from public list prices, not your provider invoice. Only calls routed through DOOR are counted.
aiSpend.budgetNear: You have used {pct}% of this month's AI budget.
aiSpend.budgetOver: You are over this month's AI budget ({pct}% used).
aiSpend.pausedTools: Paused until next month or until you raise the cap: {providers}. Calls to these providers through DOOR are refused.
aiSpend.budgetHint: You get an alert when spend passes 80% and again at 100%. Leave empty for none.
aiSpend.capHint: When a provider reaches the cap, DOOR refuses calls to it, whatever tool sends them. Leave empty for no cap.
aiSpend.blockSecretsHint: Off: keys, private keys and passwords are replaced with a mask before the prompt leaves your computer. On: the call is refused instead. This catches secrets pasted by accident; it does not decode base64 or find a secret split across several fields.
aiSpend.invalidAmount: Enter an amount of 0 or more, or leave it empty.
aiSpend.saveFailed: We could not save that. Try again.
aiSpend.capTogether: Count the cap across the whole workspace
aiSpend.capTogetherHint: Off: each person's cap counts their own devices only, and pauses the tool only for them. On: everyone's spend adds up and the tool pauses for all.

sites.title: Sites your AI tools may reach
sites.subtitle: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI may reach the sites below, and the ones you said yes to. A new site asks you first.
sites.built: Always allowed without asking: each tool's own AI provider, package registries (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems), GitHub and GitLab.
sites.coverage: On Linux computers the command-line tools Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI are filtered, with the commands they run. On Windows computers only Claude Code's own connections (native install) are filtered; commands it runs are not filtered on Windows. Other tools, editors such as Cursor and VS Code, and desktop apps are not filtered yet.
